references.text: An evil spirit from the Lord came upon Saul, showing that God can send evil spirits as judgment on people, just as he sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem.
An evil spirit from God came upon Saul, illustrating the same principle that God can allow evil spirits to influence people as part of his judgment.
The Lord permitted a lying spirit to go out into the mouths of the prophets to lure Ahab to his death. This shows God's sovereign control over spiritual forces to accomplish his judgment.
Satan was given permission by God to test Job, showing that God has sovereignty over evil forces and can use them for his purposes.
The Lord has poured out upon them a spirit of confusion, showing that God can send spiritual confusion as judgment on people.
God sends powerful delusion upon those who did not receive the truth, paralleling how God sent an evil spirit to create strife between Abimelech and the men of Shechem.
